newsitem.title: USA: Graphic Industries acquires Harvey Press.
newsitem.headline: Graphic Industries acquires Harvey Press.

text.p: Graphic Industries Inc said Monday that it has acquired privately-held Harvey Press Inc, the largest commercial printing company in New Orleans.

The price of the acquisition was not disclosed, but the company said Harvey was purchased for Graphic Industries stock. The transaction was accretive to Graphic shareholders with no dilution of earnings, added the company.

The company said the deal advances its goal of operating in every major U.S. printing market where it does not have a presence. These cities now include New York, Chicago, Denver, Kansas City, St. Louis, Phoenix, Minneapolis, Louisville and cities on the West Coast.
